column3: “If it is good upon you” is rendered “if it seems good to you,” and “let us break out, let us send” as “let us send everywhere”; “countrymen” is rendered “kinsmen.”
“To do thus” is rendered as indirect speech (“that they would do so”); “pleasing” is rendered “right.”
“Lebo Hamath” is rendered “the entrance of Hamath.”
“Baalah, to Kiriath Jearim” is rendered with “that is”; “who sits the cherubim” is rendered “who is enthroned above the cherubim,” and “where a name is called” as “where His name is called.”
NASB supplies “their” with “might”; the order of the two stringed instruments is reversed, the meaning of the instrument names is not certain.
“Because he stretched out his hand on the ark” is rendered “put out his hand to the ark.”
“It burned to David” is rendered “David became angry,” and “Yahweh had broken out a breaking out” as “the Lord's outburst.”
“Did not turn aside the ark to himself” is rendered “did not take the ark with him.”
“Household” is rendered “family”; “and all that he had” is rendered with “with.”
